source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: When your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) ends, you may pick one enemy unit no farther than 12″ away from this model. The chosen unit’s models take −1 [Toughness](vsdata:core-rule/profiles) until the next [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) you take begins.
